major_detroit313: Viktor Detroit arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a tin of tobacco and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
The first hundred were recognised, and Viktor Detroit was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.

The blanket exchange left Viktor Detroit with a better blanket and a reputation for sharp dealing. The previous owner wants a rematch. Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Viktor Detroit could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
